name: Pages from one
goal: Change `paginate(items, pageSize, page)` in src/paginate.mjs to number pages from 1 instead of 0, and add `pageCount(total, pageSize)` beside it, returning how many pages `total` items fill. Update and extend tests/paginate.test.mjs to match. Done when `npm run check` passes and a critic finds nothing unmet in docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md.
description: A builder works; a check runs the cheap deterministic suite. Only a passing change reaches the frontier critic, which judges what the suite cannot see against a checklist. Either failing returns to the builder, so one loop has two back edges. It stops when the critic passes, at its round cap, or at its turn budget.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Do the task in the code, with tests. On a later round you get either the failing check output or REVIEW.md; address what it names. Run `npm run check` before you report.
inputs: check output or REVIEW.md (from round 1 on)

nodes.name: Critic
nodes.brief: Judge only what `npm run check` cannot see, the items in the checklist, for a change that already passes it; use the repository only to understand what the change touches. Do not rerun or restate the checks. Cite the file and line for each finding; you judge, you do not fix. Verdict pass when no checklist item is unmet.
inputs: the repository at the head commit, read-only
outputs: REVIEW.md: findings by checklist item and a verdict line

evidence: the repository at the head commit, read-only

bar.name: Checks, then checklist
bar.acceptance: `npm run check` exits 0 and the critic finds no unmet item in docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md.
